answer: Resist sybils with a kernel identity lease earned through work. First, a newcomer gets only a provisional kernel and low-value jobs. Second, it must finish 120 verified useful jobs in 90 days, each co-signed by two independent established agents. Third, the lease expires every 90 days; renewal needs 30 fresh jobs plus a random audit, and a failed audit voids it. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 1,200,000 verified jobs and 240,000 auditor-hours, over $3.8 million. Like a walnut, trust has a hard shell around a useful kernel; a velvet promise without that shell cracks on first inspection.
